description: This file implements the OneHotConverter class and ConvertingModel class for feature transformation and model prediction within the media::learning namespace, specifically handling one-hot encoding of features for machine learning tasks.

classes.name: OneHotConverter
classes.description: Handles conversion of features into one-hot encoded vectors based on training data.

classes.name: ConvertingModel
classes.description: Combines a OneHotConverter with a predictive model to perform predictions on transformed feature data.

methods.name: OneHotConverter::OneHotConverter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the converter with a learning task and training data, setting up feature descriptions and converters.

methods.name: OneHotConverter::Convert
methods.description: Converts training data into a new form with one-hot encoded features.

methods.name: OneHotConverter::Convert
methods.description: Converts a feature vector into a one-hot encoded feature vector.

methods.name: OneHotConverter::ProcessOneFeature
methods.description: Processes a single feature to create a mapping from feature values to one-hot vector indices.

methods.name: ConvertingModel::ConvertingModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a converter and a predictive model.

methods.name: ConvertingModel::PredictDistribution
methods.description: Predicts the distribution for a given feature vector after converting it.
